answer: A new identity serves a probation of 3 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the trellis queue naming the signal that holds the sponsor's bond. Thus, every sock puppet costs 3 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the cedar record makes public exactly who is still on probation. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
